macros.name: Field
macros.doc: \Field{field-name} expands to the current value of the field-name-macro.

macros.name: ifFieldEmpty
macros.doc: \ifFieldEmpty takes three arguments. The first argument is a field-name and if the content of the corresponding macro is empty then the second argument is executed: otherwise the third argument is executed.

macros.name: mergeFields
macros.doc: When \mergeFields has read a row and set the field-name-macros the tex-file is read and the TeX code evaluated.
